title: We're Not from Here
cn: 第 2 集 · 我们不是本地人
novel:
Ted and Barney [[pretended|pretend]] to be [[tourists|tourist]] from out of town. They [[faked|fake]] [[foreign|foreign]] [[accents|accent]] and [[convinced|convince]] two women they were visiting New York. The [[scheme|scheme]] worked — until it didn't.

Barney [[declared|declare]] that women loved a man with a [[mysterious|mysterious]] past. Ted felt [[ridiculous|ridiculous]], but he played along. They [[deceived|deceive]] their dates for an entire evening.

Meanwhile, Lily and Marshall met with a [[financial|financial]] [[advisor|advisor]]. The numbers were [[grim|grim]]. Marshall tried to [[adjust|adjust]] to reality.

Robin [[struggled|struggle]] to [[adapt|adapt]] to Gael's [[lifestyle|lifestyle]]. His [[carefree|carefree]] attitude [[clashed|clash]] with her ambitious nature.

By midnight, the lie collapsed. The women discovered the truth and left. Ted realized that [[pretending|pretend]] to be someone else never ended well.

pretend.en: to act as if something is true when not

fake.en: to make something seem real when not

accent.en: the way people speak in an area

scheme.en: a clever plan to get what you want

deceive.en: to make someone believe false things

advisor.en: someone whose job is to give advice

adjust.en: to change to fit a new situation

adapt.en: to change behavior for a new situation
